correctness.rationale: Rebuilt Pappus graph from LCF [5,7,-7,7,-7,-5]^3 on 18 vertices with 27 edges, girth six. Primary odd-scale Čech lemma generates 27 maximal six-vertex facets, 1107 simplices, f=(18,135,396,369,162,27). Independently replayed all 422 certificate pairs and tested every lower face has precisely its designated sole proper coface, leaving core f=(18,109,136). Confirmed 17 tree edges and 92 triangle edge-killing relations trivialize all 109 edges; π1(core)=0. χ=45 gives free H2=Z44 and by Hurewicz plus homological Whitehead core ≃ wedge^44 S2. Recomputed mod-2 ranks (17,118,234,135,27) corroborate. Pure 5D and H2≠0 imply non-shellable.
